description:
Calculate the Porosity (Void Fraction) and Mean Pore Area of a sourdough bread slice using Fiji. 

1. Open the image at `~/Fiji_Data/raw/food_science/sourdough_slice.jpg`.
2. Calibrate the spatial scale: The full width of the image represents 14.0 cm. Set the unit to 'cm'.
3. Crop the image to a central ROI (approx 5x5 cm) to exclude the crust.
4. Segment the air voids (pores) using thresholding. Ensure you are measuring the dark voids, not the dough.
5. Analyze particles to measure the pore areas. Filter out noise (area < 0.005 cm²).
6. Save the measurements to `~/Fiji_Data/results/food_science/pore_measurements.csv`.
7. Save a segmentation mask screenshot to `~/Fiji_Data/results/food_science/segmentation_check.png`.
8. Create a report at `~/Fiji_Data/results/food_science/quality_report.txt` containing the calculated **Porosity %** (Total Pore Area / ROI Area * 100) and **Mean Pore Area** (in cm²).
